Core Intelligence Modules

Platform Overview

A comprehensive arsenal of enterprise-grade AI tools designed to dismantle criminal networks and optimize law enforcement operations.

AI Investigation Assistant

Multi-turn conversational intelligence powered by Gemini LLM, contextualized with millions of historical FIR records.

Criminal Network Intelligence

Uncover hidden associations and syndicate hierarchies using Neo4j-powered force-directed graph algorithms.

Digital Twin Offender Dossier

Comprehensive 360° offender profiles synthesizing criminal history, Aadhaar/PAN identity data, and SHAP risk factors.

Predictive Policing Engine

Forecast crime incidents before occurrence with XGBoost-driven spatial risk scoring and temporal modeling.

Geo Spatial Heatmaps

Interactive high-resolution OpenStreetMap tracking real-time incident densities and predictive hotspot polygons.

Real-Time Patrol Dispatch

Dispatch Hoysala & Cheetah units in real-time with cross-session officer duty tracking and GIS telemetry.

Court Reports Generator

Automated, watermarked official PDF report generation standardizing legal briefings for judiciary prosecution.

Cryptographic Audit Trail

Immutable, tamper-evident system audit logging ensuring complete accountability for all officer actions.

Cybersecurity Verified

Enterprise Hardened Security

NETRA AI implements strict government defense-in-depth security standards to eliminate attack vectors and protect law enforcement data.

Strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

JWT token claim verification enforcing granular role scopes for Officers, Inspectors, DySPs, and Commissioners.

Cryptographic Audit Logging

Immutable action trail tracking IP addresses, officer badge numbers, and timestamped API interactions.

Parameterized SQL & Cypher ORM Queries

Eliminates SQL injection and Cypher injection vulnerabilities across all database operations.

Cookie & CORS Security Hardening

Secure HttpOnly cookie handling with SameSite=Lax rules protecting against CSRF and cross-site scripting.
